newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cesp plans $500 mln Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cesp plans $500 mln Eurobond.

text.p: Sao Paulo state power generator Cesp plans to launch a $500 million Eurobond issue sometime in the first quarter of this year, Cesp's financial director Guilherme Cirne de Toledo said.
"This money will be used to lengthen the maturity period for the company's debt," Toledo told Reuters.
He said he could not give more details about the issue until after Jan 16, when the company plans to announce a lead manager for the deal.

Last year, Cesp issued 710 million Deutsche mark-denominated Eurobonds to roll over part of its mammoth $12 billion debt. Those bonds were backed by Brazil's National Treasury but the new issue would not have any government guarantees, Toledo said.

He added that the $500 million issue would be the company's only trip to global capital markets in 1997. Sao Paulo state is restructuring the company's finances ahead of its privatization, scheduled for the second half of this year.
